name: Camping Bergkristall
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Bergkristall is located in the municipality of Prägraten am Großvenediger within the Nationalpark Hohe Tauern. The area is characterized by the high-alpine scenery of the Venedigergruppe mountains. Marked hiking trails lead from the campsite into the surrounding valleys and up the peaks. In winter, the ski resorts of East Tyrol as well as routes for ski tours are accessible by car. The site features designated pitches with electricity hookups and modern sanitary facilities. A communal lounge and a roll service round out the amenities. Guests can enjoy a peaceful atmosphere, making it an ideal base for outdoor activities.
